basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and part-time nursing student from Seattle, WA. I spend my free time exploring virtual worlds and helping others navigate NCLEX study materials. I love sharing resources and engaging in community events, especially those related to my favorite games. Usually online in the evenings and over the weekends. Currently in a relationship and living with my partner. I enjoy a good balance between gaming and academic pursuits.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in healthcare, studying to become a registered nurse. I often use Reddit to exchange study tips and resources, especially for the NCLEX. My gaming knowledge is self-taught, acquired over years of playing and participating in online communities.
